summary: Russia launched a massive wave of reactive UAVs across northern, central, and southern Ukraine on 24 November 2026, striking Zaporizhzhia and Dnipro critical infrastructure with casualties and power outages. The Pentagon is delaying delivery of 60 Patriot interceptors already paid for by European allies. Ukraine confirmed destruction of a Russian corvette near Libya and signed a joint drone production agreement with Germany.
key_points: Russian reactive UAVs launched from Bryansk, Orel, Millerovo, and Gvardeyskoye targeted Chernihiv, Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Dnipro, Odesa, and Kharkiv regions. (Source: @kpszsu/98938, @eRadarrua/133041)
Russian strike on Zaporizhzhia killed 2 civilians and injured 32 including 4 children, destroying a private house and damaging a 5-story building. (Source: @UkraineNow/85502)
Russian attack on Dnipro critical infrastructure caused explosions, power outages, and possible railway station hit. (Source: @eRadarrua/133035)
Pentagon withholding ~60 Patriot interceptors from Ukraine despite European payment, suspected as leverage for territorial concessions. (Source: @UkraineNow/85508)
Ukraine and Germany agreed to jointly produce thousands of reconnaissance drones in Germany by 2027. (Source: @DeepStateUA/24024)
Ukrainian operation destroyed a Russian corvette near Libyan coast; Libya condemned the strike and demanded explanations. (Source: @UkraineNow/85501, @UkraineNow/85510)
Russian Geran-5 missile with cameras intentionally entered Polish airspace near Hhelm before returning to Volyn region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78738, @mon1tor_ua/78743)
DeepState map shows Russian forces advanced near Vozdvyzhivka and Bilohirya in eastern Ukraine. (Source: @DeepStateUA/24023)

points: Ukraine confirmed destruction of a Russian corvette near the Libyan coast, thanking SBU and Defense Forces personnel involved in the operation. (Source: @UkraineNow/85501)
Ukrainian forces struck 16 Russian Iskander-M launchers and S-400 air defense systems in recent months, while working to degrade Russian weapons production capacity. (Source: @UkraineNow/85497)

Ukraine and Germany signed an agreement in Berlin to establish a joint venture producing several thousand Ukrainian-designed reconnaissance drones annually by 2027, financed by Germany. (Source: @DeepStateUA/24024)

Ukrainian drones damaged the road section of the Crimean Bridge, disrupting Russian logistics to occupied Crimea and forcing reliance on vulnerable land routes under constant drone sanctions. (Source: @UkraineNow/85521)
A Ukrainian officer was extradited from Moldova for torturing subordinates during fortification construction in 2024, including binding a soldier to a wooden cross. (Source: @UkraineNow/85517)

Russia launched multiple groups of reactive UAVs from Bryansk Oblast, Orel (2 groups), Millerovo (2 groups), and Gvardeyskoye (1 group) targeting Ukrainian territory. (Source: @kpszsu/98938, @eRadarrua/133041)

Russian strike on Zaporizhzhia killed 2 civilians and injured 32 including 4 children (youngest under 1 year), destroying a private house and partially damaging a 5-story building. (Source: @UkraineNow/85502)

Russian attack on Dnipro critical infrastructure on evening of 24 November caused explosions, power outages across the city and region, with reports of a railway station hit. (Source: @eRadarrua/133035)
Russia currently produces one ballistic missile every 5 hours and is increasing production rates, according to Ukrainian Defense Minister Khmar. (Source: @UkraineNow/85497)

A Russian Geran-5 missile with cameras intentionally violated Polish airspace near Hhelm, flew over Helms city, and returned to Volyn Oblast, indicating deliberate probing. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78738, @mon1tor_ua/78743)

sections.threat_assessment: Russia's massive reactive UAV campaign demonstrates sustained long-range strike capacity and deliberate probing of NATO airspace via the Geran-5 incursion into Poland. The Pentagon's withholding of Patriot interceptors critically degrades Ukrainian air defense against ballistic missiles, which Russia produces at accelerating rates. Russian advances near Vozdvyzhivka and Bilohirya suggest continued pressure on eastern front lines. The Crimean Bridge damage compounds Russian logistics strain but may trigger retaliatory strikes on Ukrainian infrastructure.
sections.regional_response: Poland detected and tracked the Geran-5 incursion, confirming intentional violation with onboard cameras. Lithuania pledged €250 million in 2027 military aid and continues training Ukrainian troops under INTERFLEX and EUMAM. Germany deepens defense industrial cooperation with Ukraine through joint drone production. NATO reaffirmed collective defense including space domain. Ukraine seeks bipartisan US Congressional support if Russia delays negotiations.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Geran-5's camera-equipped flight into Poland signals Russian ISR testing of NATO border defenses. Ukrainian strikes on 16 Iskander/S-400 systems indicate effective counter-battery and SEAD operations. The Pentagon's Patriot delay aligns with Trump administration pressure for territorial concessions per Financial Times. Fires at Russian industrial sites in Tolyatti and Lipetsk may reflect sabotage or accidents but lack confirmed attribution. Ukrainian domestic issues include tuberculosis outbreak in Cherkasy and corruption convictions.
